svg.title: Noctiluca curriculum
svg.desc: The first twenty levels are hand-authored. Levels 21 to 1000 are generated across ten tiers of 98 levels, from output and strings through loops, functions, collections, recursion, classes, classic algorithms and dynamic programming, using 157 puzzle families. Essence per level rises from 12 to 30.
svg.text: print, variables, loops, slicing, functions, Fibonacci, primes, a pyramid
accumulators, while loops, break, patterns, tables
default arguments, list methods, sorting, averages
filtering, map and lambda, any / all, flattening
binary search, two sum, run-length, matrices
980 generated levels = 10 tiers × 98. Each tier draws from its own families with a seeded generator, so every build is identical.
